disagreements.question: How do I send an email with the API?
disagreements.draft_answer:
To send an email with the API, you can use the following methods provided in the documentation:

* **POST Send Email**: `https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email` [Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/api-keys/list-api-keys]
* **POST Send Batch Emails**: `https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-batch-emails` [Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/api-keys/list-api-keys]

Additionally, API keys used for sending must have the appropriate permissions (`full_access` or `sending_access`) [Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/api-keys/create-api-key].

disagreements.question: What is session replay?
disagreements.draft_answer: Session replay records what real users do in your product and plays it back like a DVR [Source: https://posthog.com/docs/session-replay]. It includes a synced DevTools panel that shows console logs, network requests, and errors at the exact moment they occurred [Source: https://posthog.com/docs/session-replay].

details.question: How does row level security work?
details.draft_answer: Row Level Security (RLS) works by implementing granular authorization rules directly inside your Postgres database to secure data at the row level [Source: https://supabase.com/features/row-level-security]. It uses a combination of grants and policies to control access and secure your data [Source: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security].
